lines: So me attho anuppatto, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayoti yo sabbesaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ khayabhūto khayena vā laddhabbo, so sadattho paramattho ca mayā ariyamaggādhigamena adhigatoti.
Evametāya gāthāya therassa aññābyākaraṇaṃ ahosīti veditabbo.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinanto padumuttarassa bhagavato kāle kulagehe nibbattitvā, vayappatto satthu santike dhammaṃ suṇanto satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ mahāparisānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā, sayampi taṃ ṭhānantaraṃ patthetvā mahādānaṃ datvā paṇidhānamakāsi.
Bhagavā cassa anantarāyataṃ disvā,“anāgate gotamabuddhassa sāsane mahāparisānaṃ aggo bhavissatī”ti byākāsi.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: So tattha yāvajīvaṃ puññāni katvā tato cavitvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto ito dvānavutikappamatthake phussassa bhagavato vemātikakaniṭṭhabhātā hutvā nibbatti.

Te tayopi buddhappamukhaṃ saṅghaṃ paramāya pūjāya pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto amhākaṃ bhagavato nibbattito puretarameva bārāṇasiyaṃ brāhmaṇakule bhātaro hutvā, anukkamena nibbattā gottavasena tayopi kassapā eva nāma jātā.
Tesaṃ jeṭṭhabhātikassa pañca māṇavakasatāni parivāro, majjhimassa tīṇi, kaniṭṭhassa dve.
Te attano ganthe sāraṃ olokentā diṭṭhadhammikameva atthaṃ disvā pabbajjaṃ rocesuṃ.

Tesu jeṭṭhabhātā attano parivārena saddhiṃ uruvelaṃ gantvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā uruvelakassapo nāma jāto mahāgaṅgānadīvaṅke pabbajito nadīkassapo nāma jāto, gayāsīse pabbajito gayākassapo nāma jāto.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ tesu isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā tattha tattha vasantesu bahūnaṃ divasānaṃ accayena amhākaṃ bodhisatto mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā, paṭividdhasabbaññutaññāṇo anukkamena dhammacakkaṃ pavattetvā, pañcavaggiyatthere arahatte patiṭṭhāpetvā yasappamukhe pañcapaññāsa sahāyake vinetvā saṭṭhi arahante “caratha, bhikkhave, cārikan”ti vissajjetvā, bhaddavaggiye vinetvā uruvelakassapassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā vasanatthāya agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā, tattha katanāgadamanaṃ ādiṃ katvā aḍḍhuḍḍhasahassehi pāṭihāriyehi uruvelakassapaṃ saparisaṃ vinetvā pabbājesi.
Tassa pabbajitabhāvaṃ ñatvā itarepi dve bhātaro saparisā āgantvā satthu santike pabbajiṃsu.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā taṃ samaṇasahassaṃ ādāya gayāsīsaṃ gantvā piṭṭhipāsāṇe nisinno ādittapariyāyadesanāya sabbe arahatte patiṭṭhāpesi.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so, tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Parisā mahatī hotu, nibbattassa tahiṃ tahiṃ.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Kassapo nāma gottena, hessati satthu sāvako.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “So ca sabbaṃ tamaṃ hantvā, vijaṭetvā mahājaṭaṃ;

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Khemaṃ vijiritaṃ katvā, puna dethāti bhāsatha.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Nibbute tamhi lokagge, pūjaṃ katvā yathābalaṃ.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Bahudhā saṃsito santo, diṭṭhiṃ hitvāna pāpikaṃ.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Tadā dve bhātaro mayhaṃ, pabbajiṃsu mayā saha;

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tato me āsi paññatti, uruvelakassapo iti.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Mama pañca satānūnā, sissā sabbe mamānugā.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Tadā upecca maṃ buddho, katvāna vividhāni me;

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Te cevaññe ca bahavo, sissā maṃ parivārayuṃ;

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Aho buddhe kataṃ kāraṃ, saphalaṃ me ajāyatha.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Arahattaṃ pana patvā attano paṭipattiṃ paccavekkhitvā sīhanādaṃ nadanto –

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tato me āsi saṃvego, abbhuto lomahaṃsano.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tattha disvāna pāṭihīrānīti nāgarājadamanādīni aḍḍhuḍḍhasahassāni pāṭihāriyāni disvā.
“Pāṭihīraṃ, pāṭiheraṃ, pāṭihāriyan”ti hi atthato ekaṃ, byañjanameva nānaṃ.
Yasassino”ti “itipi so bhagavā”tiādinā sadevake loke yathābhuccaṃ patthaṭakittisaddassa.

Na tāvāhaṃ paṇipatinti yāva maṃ bhagavā “neva kho tvaṃ, kassapa, arahā, nāpi arahattamaggaṃ samāpanno, sāpi te paṭipadā natthi, yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assa, arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno”ti na tajjesi, tāva ahaṃ na paṇipātanaṃ akāsiṃ.

Issāmānena vañcito,“imassa mayi sāvakattaṃ upagate mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati, imassa eva vaḍḍhissatī”ti evaṃ parasampattiasahanalakkhaṇāya issāya ceva,“ahaṃ gaṇapāmokkho bahujanasammato”ti evaṃ abbhunnatilakkhaṇena mānena ca vañcito, palambhito hutvāti attho.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Mama saṅkappamaññāyāti mayhaṃ micchāsaṅkappaṃ jānitvā, yaṃ yaṃ bhagavā uttari manussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dasseti, taṃ taṃ disvā “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo”ti cintetvāpi “na tveva kho arahā yathā ahan”ti evaṃ pavattaṃ micchāvitakkaṃ jānantopi ñāṇaparipākaṃ āgamento ajjhupekkhitvā pacchā nerañjarāya majjhe samantato udakaṃ ussāretvā reṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkamitvā tena ābhatanāvāya ṭhito tadāpi “mahiddhiko”tiādikaṃ cintetvā puna “na tveva kho arahā yathā ahan”ti pavattitaṃ micchāsaṅkappaṃ ñatvāti attho.
Codesi narasārathīti tadā me ñāṇaparipākaṃ ñatvā “neva kho tvaṃ arahā”tiādinā purisadammasārathi satthā maṃ codesi niggaṇhi.

Tato me āsi saṃvego, abbhuto lomahaṃsanoti tato yathāvuttacodanāhetu ettakaṃ kālaṃ abhūtapubbatāya abbhuto lomahaṃsanavasena pavattiyā lomahaṃsano “anarahāva samāno ‘arahā’ti maññin”ti saṃvego sahottappo ñāṇuppādo mayhaṃ ahosi.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Yaññena santuṭṭhoti “yaññaṃ yajitvā saggasukhaṃ anubhavissāmi, alamettāvatā”ti yaññayajanena santuṭṭho niṭṭhitakiccasaññī.
Kāmadhātupurakkhatoti kāmasugatiṃ ārabbha uppannataṇho yaññayajanena kāmalokaṃ purakkhatvā ṭhito.
So ce yañño pāṇātipātapaṭisaṃyutto hoti, na tena sugatiṃ sakkā laddhuṃ.
Na hi akusalassa iṭṭho kanto vipāko nibbattati.
Yā pana tattha dānādikusalacetanā, tāya sati paccayasamavāye sugatiṃ gaccheyya.
Pacchāti tāpasapabbajjāto pacchā satthu ovādena tāpasaladdhiṃ pahāya catusaccakammaṭṭhānānuyogakāle.
Samūhaninti vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā rāgañca dosañca mohañca anavasesato samugghātesiṃ.

before.title: Uruvelakassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Yasmā panāyaṃ thero ariyamaggena rāgādayo samūhanantoyeva chaḷabhiñño ahosi, tasmā taṃ attano chaḷabhiññabhāvaṃ dassento “pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmī”tiādimāha.
Tattha pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmīti attano paresañca pubbenivāsaṃ atītāsu jātīsu nibbattakkhandhe khandhapaṭibaddhe ca pubbenivāsañāṇena hatthatale āmalakaṃ viya paccakkhato jānāmi bujjhāmi.

Dibbacakkhu visodhitanti dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ visodhitaṃ, pakaticakkhunā āpāthagataṃ pakatirūpaṃ viya dibbaṃ mānusampi dūraṃ tiroṭṭhitaṃ atisukhumañca rūpaṃ vibhāvetuṃ samatthañāṇaṃ bhāvanāya mayā visuddhaṃ katvā paṭiladdhanti attho.
Sarāgādibhedassa paresaṃ cittassa jānanato paracittaññū, cetopariyañāṇalābhīti vuttaṃ hoti.
